fatal_errors: DFT calculations and machine-learning potentials are incorrectly presented as a method that physically produces three-dimensional nanoframeworks.
The actual spray-drying/thermal decomposition-reduction synthesis is entirely omitted.
The cited evidence concerns melting predictions for refractory TaVCrW and thermal behavior of AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles, not synthesis of noble-metal HEA three-dimensional nanoframeworks.
No relevant synthesis conditions, precursor chemistry, hydrogen reduction, or framework-formation mechanism are specified.
explanation: The response recognizes the broad topic of NM-HEAs but does not reconstruct the reported production method. The target uses spray drying of homogeneously mixed salts followed by H2 reduction, normally at 300°C for 30 minutes, to form porous HEA three-dimensional nanoframeworks. DFT was used only to investigate hydrogen-assisted reduction and phase transformations, not as the fabrication intervention. The proposed mechanism and outcome are generic and unsupported, while the baseline, boundaries, and falsification experiment are vague or category-confused. None of the cited evidence validates the claimed synthesis route.
